title: Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform
description:
Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Pricing & Order Platform, a critical system that powers how we price, structure, and execute deals across multiple product ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, financial logic, and system architecture. You will be responsible for building scalable pricing capabilities, enabling complex deal mechanics, and expanding our order‑taking platform across both online and offline channels.

You’ll work closely with engineering, finance, operations, and commercial teams to ensure our platform is flexible, accurate, and scalable, while supporting increasingly complex business models.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the end‑to‑end product strategy for pricing and order‑taking systems (e.g., defining how a new product line plugs into existing pricing flows without breaking current deals)
  • Define and evolve pricing logic, deal structures, and financial flows (e.g., tiered pricing, bundled discounts, commissions, payment splits, financing fees)
  • Drive the expansion of the order‑taking platform across multiple product lines and channels (e.g., enabling the same order to be created via sales reps offline and completed online by customers)
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable system designs (e.g., turning “custom discount rules per partner” into a configurable rule engine instead of hardcoded logic)
  • Partner with engineering to design robust, maintainable architectures (e.g., defining when to use configuration vs. code, or when to introduce a rules engine vs. service logic)
  • Balance flexibility vs. control in pricing and deal configuration (e.g., allowing sales teams to configure deals without creating financial or legal risks)
  • Ensure accuracy, auditability, and reliability in financial calculations (e.g., guaranteeing totals match across UI, backend, invoices, and accounting systems)
  • Identify opportunities to automate and simplify operational processes (e.g., replacing manual deal validation spreadsheets with system‑driven validation rules)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align product capabilities with commercial strategy (e.g., enabling a new go‑to‑market model without requiring engineering changes every time)

Key Challenges You’ll Solve:

  • Designing a scalable pricing engine (e.g., supporting both simple fixed pricing and highly customised enterprise deals in the same system)
  • Managing complex deal configurations (e.g., combinations of discounts, add‑ons, financing, and conditional fees)
  • Ensuring financial correctness and consistency (e.g., avoiding rounding errors, mismatches between systems, or incorrect fee applications)
  • Balancing customisation vs. standardisation (e.g., preventing one‑off deal logic from polluting the core system)
  • Integrating online and offline order flows (e.g., syncing a salesperson‑created quote with a self‑serve checkout flow)
  • Reducing operational dependency (e.g., minimising reliance on ops teams to manually fix or validate deals)
  • Enabling fast experimentation (e.g., launching a new pricing model via configuration instead of a full release cycle)
  • Making trade‑offs between performance, flexibility, and simplicity (e.g., deciding between real‑time pricing calculation vs. pre‑computed values)

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building up world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognise the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We’re Looking For:

Core Skills:

  • Strong experience as a Product Manager in technical or platform teams (e.g., owned internal platforms, APIs, or systems used by multiple teams rather than just end‑user features)
  • Experience with complex systems (e.g., pricing engines, billing platforms, marketplaces, logistics systems, or payment flows)
  • Ability to understand and discuss system design and architecture (e.g., comfortable debating API contracts, data flows, service boundaries with engineers)
  • Solid grasp of data modelling, APIs, and rule‑based systems (e.g., designing entities like “Order”, “Quote”, “Pricing Rule”, and how they relate and evolve)
  • Strong analytical thinking (e.g., breaking down a pricing discrepancy into its root cause across multiple systems)
  • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured solutions (e.g., turning “we need flexible discounts” into a defined set of configurable rule types and constraints)

Differentiators:

  • Experience with pricing engines, billing systems, or financial platforms (e.g., worked on subscription billing, transaction fees, or dynamic pricing models)
  • Background in marketplaces, fintech, or e‑commerce platforms (e.g., handling multi‑party transactions, commissions, or complex checkout flows)
  • Familiarity with rule engines or configuration‑driven systems (e.g., tools where non‑engineers can define pricing logic or workflows)
  • Experience handling multi‑product or multi‑channel platforms (e.g., one platform serving different products, regions, and sales channels)
  • Strong understanding of scalability trade‑offs (e.g., knowing when abstraction adds value vs. unnecessary complexity)

Mindset We Value:

  • Systems thinker (e.g., understands how a pricing change impacts finance, UX, ops, and reporting)
  • Pragmatic (e.g., avoids over‑engineering while still planning for future scale)
  • Ownership‑driven (e.g., takes responsibility for revenue impact, not just feature delivery)
  • Detail‑oriented (e.g., catches edge cases like conflicting discounts or invalid deal states)
  • Collaborative (e.g., aligns sales, finance, and engineering around trade‑offs and priorities)

Why This Role Matters:

This platform sits at the core of the business. Every deal, every order, every financial outcome depends on it. Your work will directly impact revenue, scalability, and operational efficiency.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

title: Data Scientist [All Levels]
description:
About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our institutional page

Data Science at Nubank

Data Science is essential to every part of the business at Nubank, since Day 1. Most areas of the company use data science to some extent. Data Scientists are responsible for translating business needs into models and other types of data-driven solutions.

As a Data Scientist, you’re expected to

  • Interact with other team members to understand how to best apply data science and artificial intelligence to Nubank’s problems;
  • Investigate problems and discover insights through exploratory data analysis and other quantitative methods;
  • Have great numerical and analytical literacy, including knowledge of statistics and linear algebra as needed;
  • Work on multiple stages of the ML model lifecycle–from ideation to training and steady-state operation;
  • Work across multiple types of models, algorithms and learning paradigms;
  • Communicate technical points, decisions and tradeoffs to peers and stakeholders;

Our ideal candidate

  • Has experience working with ML models in a production environment;
  • Understands possible pitfalls and tradeoffs when applying ML to real-word, sometimes messy problems;
  • Is familiar with the technical aspects of learning theory and algorithms and is able to discuss details if needed;
  • Has experience working with the Python scientific stack (Numpy, Pandas, Scipy, Sklearn, Boosted Tree Libraries, etc);
  • Has experience working with Tensor/Deep Learning libraries such as Tensorflow and Pytorch;
  • Is able to connect analytical outcomes to business priorities and advise stakeholders on the best course of action;
  • Has good communication skills and is able to convey technical topics and decision points to diverse audiences;
  • Has experience writing general-purpose code using modern tools;
  • Understands the implications of causality when applying ML to problems;
  • Is up-to-date with recent developments in the area as a whole and is able to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation;

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

title: Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform
description:
Product Manager | Pricing & Order Platform

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Pricing & Order Platform, a critical system that powers how we price, structure, and execute deals across multiple product ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, financial logic, and system architecture. You will be responsible for building scalable pricing capabilities, enabling complex deal mechanics, and expanding our order‑taking platform across both online and offline channels.

You’ll work closely with engineering, finance, operations, and commercial teams to ensure our platform is flexible, accurate, and scalable, while supporting increasingly complex business models.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy for pricing and order-taking systems (e.g., defining how a new product line plugs into existing pricing flows without breaking current deals)
  • Define and evolve pricing logic, deal structures, and financial flows (e.g., tiered pricing, bundled discounts, commissions, payment splits, financing fees)
  • Drive the expansion of the order-taking platform across multiple product lines and channels (e.g., enabling the same order to be created via sales reps offline and completed online by customers)
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable system designs (e.g., turning “custom discount rules per partner” into a configurable rule engine instead of hardcoded logic)
  • Partner with engineering to design robust, maintainable architectures (e.g., defining when to use configuration vs. code, or when to introduce a rules engine vs. service logic)
  • Balance flexibility vs. control in pricing and deal configuration (e.g., allowing sales teams to configure deals without creating financial or legal risks)
  • Ensure accuracy, auditability, and reliability in financial calculations (e.g., guaranteeing totals match across UI, backend, invoices, and accounting systems)
  • Identify opportunities to automate and simplify operational processes (e.g., replacing manual deal validation spreadsheets with system‑driven validation rules)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align product capabilities with commercial strategy (e.g., enabling a new go‑to‑market model without requiring engineering changes every time)

Key Challenges You’ll Solve

  • Designing a scalable pricing engine (e.g., supporting both simple fixed pricing and highly customized enterprise deals in the same system)
  • Managing complex deal configurations (e.g., combinations of discounts, add‑ons, financing, and conditional fees)
  • Ensuring financial correctness and consistency (e.g., avoiding rounding errors, mismatches between systems, or incorrect fee applications)
  • Balancing customization vs. Standardization (e.g., preventing one‑off deal logic from polluting the core system)
  • Integrating online and offline order flows (e.g., syncing a salesperson‑created quote with a self‑serve checkout flow)
  • Reducing operational dependency (e.g., minimizing reliance on ops teams to manually fix or validate deals)
  • Enabling fast experimentation (e.g., launching a new pricing model via configuration instead of a full release cycle)
  • Making trade‑offs between performance, flexibility, and simplicity (e.g., deciding between real‑time pricing calculation vs. precomputed values)

More About You

  • You're passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You're motivated by building up world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You're creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We’re Looking For

Core Skills

  • Strong experience as a Product Manager in technical or platform teams (e.g., owned internal platforms, APIs, or systems used by multiple teams rather than just end‑user features)
  • Experience with complex systems (e.g., pricing engines, billing platforms, marketplaces, logistics systems, or payment flows)
  • Ability to understand and discuss system design and architecture (e.g., comfortable debating API contracts, data flows, service boundaries with engineers)
  • Solid grasp of data modeling, APIs, and rule‑based systems (e.g., designing entities like “Order”, “Quote”, “Pricing Rule”, and how they relate and evolve)
  • Strong analytical thinking (e.g., breaking down a pricing discrepancy into its root cause across multiple systems)
  • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured solutions (e.g., turning “we need flexible discounts” into a defined set of configurable rule types and constraints)

Differentiators

  • Experience with pricing engines, billing systems, or financial platforms (e.g., worked on subscription billing, transaction fees, or dynamic pricing models)
  • Background in marketplaces, fintech, or e‑commerce platforms (e.g., handling multi‑party transactions, commissions, or complex checkout flows)
  • Familiarity with rule engines or configuration‑driven systems (e.g., tools where non‑engineers can define pricing logic or workflows)
  • Experience handling multi‑product or multi‑channel platforms (e.g., one platform serving different products, regions, or sales channels)
  • Strong understanding of scalability trade‑offs (e.g., knowing when abstraction adds value vs. unnecessary complexity)

Mindset We Value

  • Systems thinker (e.g., understands how a pricing change impacts finance, UX, ops, and reporting)
  • Pragmatic (e.g., avoids over‑engineering while still planning for future scale)
  • Ownership‑driven (e.g., takes responsibility for revenue impact, not just feature delivery)
  • Detail‑oriented (e.g., catches edge cases like conflicting discounts or invalid deal states)
  • Collaborative (e.g., aligns sales, finance, and engineering around trade‑offs and priorities)

Why This Role Matters

This platform sits at the core of the business. Every deal, every order, every financial outcome depends on it. Your work will directly impact revenue, scalability, and operational efficiency.

What We Offer

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance

We are seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Senior Analyst to contribute to our data strategy and elevate our analytical capabilities using Power BI.

This role, as part of Finance Business Partnering and FP&A , is responsible for:

You will build scalable data models, support data‑driven growth, and work closely with other departments to ensure the company has the visibility required to optimize performance and drive strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high‑performance Power BI reports and interactive dashboards.
  • Build and optimize sophisticated DAX measures for complex business logic and KPIs.
  • Develop scalable data models (Star Schema/Snowflake) that ensure "one version of the truth" across the organization.
  • Implement Row‑Level Security (RLS) and manage workspaces, apps, and permissions within the Power BI Service.
  • Develop and optimize Power Query (M) transformations to ingest and clean data from diverse sources (ERP, CRM, SQL databases, Excel).
  • Collaborate with IT to influence the design of data warehouses and underlying SQL views to support BI requirements.
  • Oversee data refresh schedules and monitor gateway performance to ensure 100% data reliability.
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and perform root‑cause analysis on data quality issues.

Business Analysis & Insights

  • Strongly contribute to the department role of strategic partner to management from various departments and entities, to identify reporting needs and define KPIs.
  • Translate non‑technical business requirements into technical specifications for BI solutions.
  • Conduct deep‑ dive analyses to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for cost reduction or revenue growth.
  • Provide training and documentation to empower end‑users with self‑service analytics capabilities.

Strategy, Governance & Innovation

  • Establish and maintain BI best practices, including version control, documentation, and naming conventions.
  • Define the roadmap for data analytics, ensuring alignment with the broader business strategy and IT infrastructure.
  • Stay current with Power BI monthly updates and emerging AI/ML features to drive continuous improvement.
  • Lead the transition from static reporting to predictive and prescriptive analytics.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) is highly preferred.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analysis, ideally within a manufacturing or engineering environment.
  • Proven track record of delivering end‑to‑end Power BI solutions from data extraction to executive‑level visualization.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, NetSuite) is an asset.

Technical Skills:

  • Expert Power BI: Advanced DAX , Power Query (M), and data modeling expertise.
  • SQL Mastery: Strong ability to write and optimize complex queries to extract data.
  • Data Visualization: Mastery of UI/UX principles to create intuitive, clean, and impactful dashboards.
  • Excel: Advanced proficiency (Power Pivot, VBA is a plus) for ad‑hoc analysis.

Business & Soft Skills:

  • Analytical Mindset: Able to connect data points to real‑world business outcomes like margin analysis and product lifecycle analysis.
  • Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical data concepts to non‑specialists and senior leadership.
  • Project Management: Highly organized and able to manage multiple reporting projects simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment.

Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para integrar nossa equipe na área de Supply Chain, com foco em abastecimento e análise de vendas.   • Experiência em gestão de estoques, planejamento de demanda e logística de distribuição.

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

title: LATAM Engineering Director - Power Conversion
description:
Job Description Summary

The Director of Engineering leads a comprehensive organization of Design, Product, Test and Process engineers responsible for the end-to-end design of Large Rotating Machines (motors, generators and synchronous condensers), Transformers, Power Drives, Switch Gear and Complex Systems for a variety of industry segments. With design authority (under corporate standards), you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, and be instrumental to the overall business strategy.

Job Description

Role Summary/Purpose:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for the Power Conversion and Storage division in Latin America, the LATAM Director of Engineering will lead Engineering on Rotating machines (induction, DC, synchronous, PMM, synch reluctance, and other topologies) and Engineering of integrated electrical solutions (system design and integration, power electronics, automation, switchboards and installation) for products and projects within LATAM or exported from LATAM to many global regions, notably North America, Europe and the Middle East.

The role is both operational and strategic. It demands:

  • Transformational leadership skills – to guide the large organizational structure towards productivity, process standardization & maturity, speed and use of leading edge technology tools;

  • Technical depth – to foster an environment of creativity and innovative solutions, and to develop new business opportunities;

  • Seniority and executive presence – to interact with the customers in Latin America and abroad on complex engineering projects.

  • The role requires focus towards growth on the Latam region operation, and he/she will leverage the GE network, to drive product innovation, technology injections, structuring and cost-out through tools and processes in the areas of power electronics, automation, power systems, switchgears, rotor dynamics, vibration, electromagnetics, insulation, aero-thermo, structural, and both electrical and mechanical systems integration.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • The LATAM Director of Engineering directs a functional area of several engineering departments across the sites of Campinas, SP and Belo Horizonte, MG. Executes projects with great customer engagement and trust. Translates concepts, considers strategic options, develops tactics, and implements change. Creates programs in alignment with the external environment. Participates in cross-functional , multi-cultural teams.

  • Drives team performance to meet aggressive time and cost demands from our customers.

  • Develop, implement, and achieve performance KPIs.

  • Develop a roadmap for building world-class products and solutions, including electric machines, power electronics, switchgears, software and overall systems design capability.

  • Serves as technical expert in the technical community through demonstrated technical accomplishments which may include holding patents, component design and systems design experience, and strong knowledge of engineering design fundamentals.

  • Drives customer project execution and delivers on time and quality.

  • Leads and oversees quality engineering design, execution, and product safety; responsible for the oversight of the related sciences including materials and performance.

  • Provides guidance, leadership, mentoring and intervention, as necessary, to strengthen the discipline, quality, reliability and rigor of our engineering work.

  • Leads interactions with customers on technical issues.

  • Works with Power Conversion leadership to develop and build long term strategies.

  • Interacts with P&L engineering and technology leaders across GE to accelerate deployment of modern electrical and mechanical design tools and methodologies.

  • Works with P&L product leadership to reshape the overall Latam technical strategy and the organizational structure.

  • Provides leadership with high integrity and oversight of processes protecting intellectual property, export controlled and strategic technology.

Required Qualification:

  • Degree in Electric or Mechanical Engineering
  • Strong knowledge of Engineering Design Fundamentals and Engineering Processes
  • Extensive experience in mechanical and/or electrical systems design
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese mandatory
  • Industrial experience in relevant industry segments such as Oil and Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Steel and/or Marine will be a plus.
  • Subject Matter Expertise on Rotating Machines and/or Electrical Systems will be a plus.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Subscription Services Leader (12563)
description:

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Nosso compromisso é garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Qual a missão do Cargo?

O Subscription Services Leader é a liderança estratégica responsável por estruturar, escalar e consolidar o Pool de Ofertas de Subscription Services da consultoria da Sensedia, transformando capacidades técnicas recorrentes em um modelo sustentável, previsível e orientado a valor contínuo para os clientes. Sua missão é consolidar o modelo de serviços recorrentes da consultoria como um dos pilares estratégicos de crescimento, garantindo previsibilidade de receita, aumento de margem e fortalecimento do relacionamento contínuo com os clientes.

Com forte visão de negócio e mentalidade orientada a serviços recorrentes, possui experiência na construção e gestão de modelos baseados em receita previsível (ARR/MRR), governança contratual e eficiência operacional. Atua como responsável por transformar competências técnicas em ofertas padronizadas, escaláveis e financeiramente sustentáveis.

Domina e acompanha de forma estruturada as principais métricas de SaaS aplicáveis ao modelo de Subscription Services, como ARR, MRR, churn, Net Dollar Retention (NDR), CAC, LTV, margem, expansão de base e indicadores de adoção e engajamento. Utiliza esses indicadores como base para a tomada de decisão, priorização e evolução do portfólio.

É responsável por liderar a estratégia do portfólio de Subscription Services, estruturar pacotes de oferta, modelos de precificação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e governança operacional alinhada com demais stakeholders da Sensedia. Desenha e desdobra OKRs, metas e KPIs relacionados a crescimento, rentabilidade e satisfação do cliente, garantindo acompanhamento disciplinado e execução consistente.

Essa liderança tem como objetivo estratégico atingir R$ 10 milhões de ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) em Subscription Services até o final de 2026, via transição de contratos atuais ou novos que se enquadrem no modelo de Subscription Services, assegurando crescimento sustentável.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Estruturar e escalar o Pool de Subscription Services com ofertas claras, padronizadas e replicáveis
  • Definir e evoluir modelos de precificação, SLAs e governança operacional
  • Estabelecer, acompanhar e analisar métricas SaaS aplicáveis ao modelo de serviços recorrentes
  • Definir e desdobrar OKRs, metas e KPIs de receita recorrente, margem, retenção, expansão e satisfação.
  • Garantir eficiência operacional, qualidade consistente e experiência positiva do cliente
  • Conectar estratégia comercial, capacidade técnica e execução operacional.
  • Evoluir continuamente o portfólio com base em dados, feedback de clientes e oportunidades de mercado
  • Participar de agendas de pré-vendas ou de conversão de contratos de modelo tradicional da consultoria para subscription services
  • Trabalhar de forma transversal com Produto, Marketing, Vendas, Pré-vendas, Customer Success e Consultoria, assegurando que as ofertas sejam claras, executáveis e alinhadas ao plano estratégico da consultoria.
  • Ao estruturar e governar o modelo de Subscription Services com base em métricas, disciplina operacional e foco em cliente, essa liderança fortalece a previsibilidade financeira da consultoria, aumenta a recorrência de receita e sustenta o crescimento estratégico da Sensedia.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência na liderança ou gestão de iniciativas, projetos ou portfólio de serviços dentro de estruturas de serviços ou consultoria
  • Capacidade de estruturar e evoluir ofertas de serviços de forma organizada, escalável e orientada a valor para o cliente
  • Experiência na definição e acompanhamento de metas e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), preferencialmente ligados a crescimento de serviços, eficiência operacional ou satisfação do cliente

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com modelos de receita recorrente ou serviços gerenciados

title: Especialista em Desenvolvimento Tecnológico Jr (Linha de Luz Sussuarana) | Technical Specialist[...]
description:
Job description

Para atuar na Linha de Luz Sussuarana do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).

O(a) Especialista Técnico(a) atuará no projeto, construção, comissionamento e operação da linha de luz Sussuarana, dedicada a experimentos termomecânicos in situ e à síntese/processamento de materiais volumétricos sob altas pressões e temperaturas.

A posição é voltada a profissionais com forte formação técnica em instrumentação científica, engenharia mecânica, mecatrônica, materiais ou áreas correlatas, com experiência em integração de sistemas experimentais, automação e operação de equipamentos complexos. O(a) profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com pesquisadores da linha, contribuindo para a confiabilidade, segurança e desempenho da infraestrutura experimental e apoiando usuários durante a realização de experimentos.

English Version

To work in Sussuarana Beamline of the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).

The Technical Specialist will contribute to the design, construction, commissioning, and operation of the Sussuarana beamline, dedicated to in situ thermomechanical experiments and bulk material synthesis/processing under high pressure and high temperature.

The position targets professionals with a strong technical background in scientific instrumentation, mechanical/mechatronics/materials engineering, or related fields, with experience in experimental system integration, automation, and operation of complex equipment. The specialist will work closely with beamline scientists, contributing to the reliability, safety, and performance of the experimental infrastructure and supporting users during experiments.

Main responsibilities

  • Participar da montagem, integração e comissionamento de estações experimentais e sistemas auxiliares da linha de luz;
  • Operar e manter equipamentos para experimentos sob alta pressão e alta temperatura, incluindo dispositivos de ensaio termomecânico e prensas de grande volume;
  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas para automação, controle e aquisição de dados dos experimentos;
  • Preparar amostras e auxiliar na instalação de experimentos durante campanhas de usuários;
  • Apoiar, orientar e treinar usuários na operação segura dos equipamentos;
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva, garantindo estabilidade operacional e disponibilidade da linha;
  • Documentar procedimentos operacionais, protocolos de segurança e rotinas de manutenção;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de engenharia, TI e pesquisadores para melhoria contínua da infraestrutura.

English Version

  • Participate in the assembly, integration, and commissioning of experimental stations and auxiliary beamline systems;
  • Operate and maintain equipment for high-pressure and high-temperature experiments, including thermomechanical testing devices and large-volume presses;
  • Develop technical solutions for experiment automation, control, and data acquisition;
  • Prepare samples and assist in experimental setup during user runs;
  • Support, guide, and train users in safe equipment operation;
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure operational stability and beamline availability;
  • Document operating procedures, safety protocols, and maintenance routines;
  • Work with engineering, IT, and scientific teams for continuous infrastructure improvement.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Física, Engenharia (Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Materiais, Controle e Automação, Elétrica) ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação Completa em Física, Engenharia (Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Materiais, Controle e Automação, Elétrica) ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Experiência com instrumentação científica, sistemas eletromecânicos ou equipamentos laboratoriais complexos;
  • Experiência em integração de hardware, sensores, atuadores e sistemas de controle;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de programação e aquisição de dados (Python, EPICS, LabVIEW ou similares);
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambiente multidisciplinar e de suporte a usuários.

Desejável

  • Experiência com equipamentos para ensaios termo-mecânicos, manufatura aditiva de metais, e prensas de grande volume;
  • Experiência em grandes instalações científicas (síncrotrons, fontes de nêutrons ou laboratórios multiusuários);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de vácuo, criogenia, fornos, hidráulica ou pneumática;
  • Experiência com normas de segurança e análise de risco experimental.

English Version

  • Bachelor’s degree in Physics or Engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Materials, Control & Automation, Electrical) or related fields;
  • Postgraduate degree in Physics, Engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Materials, Control & Automation, Electrical) or related fields;
  • Intermediate English proficiency;
  • Experience with scientific instrumentation, electromechanical systems, or complex laboratory equipment;
  • Experience integrating hardware, sensors, actuators, and control systems;
  • Basic programming and data acquisition skills (Python, EPICS, LabVIEW, or similar);
  • Ability to work in a multidisciplinary, user-support environment.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience with thermomechanical testing equipment, metal additive manufacturing, or large-volume presses;
  • Experience at large-scale research facilities (synchrotrons, neutron sources, or multi-user laboratories);
  • Knowledge of vacuum systems, cryogenics, furnaces, hydraulics, or pneumatics;
  • Experience with safety standards and experimental risk assessment.

description:
Somos especialistas em transformação tecnológica , unindo expertise humana à IA para criar soluções tech escaláveis. Com mais de 8,000 CI&Ters ao redor do mundo, já formamos parcerias com mais de 1,000 clientes durante nossos 30 anos de história. Inteligência Artificial é nossa realidade.

Importante : se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento de Lógica de Banco de Dados: Criar e manter scripts complexos, Stored Procedures, Functions e Triggers utilizando SQL e SQL Procedural Language;
  • Otimização e Tuning: Expertise no uso de ferramentas de Explain (db2exfmt, Visual Explain) para análise profunda de caminhos de acesso e métodos de join, visando a redução de consumo de recursos e tempo de resposta;
  • Manutenção de Performance: Executar e automatizar rotinas de manutenção essenciais, como RUNSTATS (atualização de estatísticas) e REORG (reorganização de tabelas e índices) para garantir a eficiência do storage;
  • Modelagem de Dados e Objetos: Atuar na concepção e alteração de tabelas, índices (B-tree, MDC, ITC) e views, além da gestão de Tablespaces (Bufferpools, Page Sizes), garantindo a integridade e a performance desde a camada física até o modelo lógico;
  • Troubleshooting e Concorrência: Diagnosticar problemas de performance em produção, como bloqueios (locks, deadlocks e timeouts), analisando níveis de isolamento e propondo melhorias estruturais ou de código para maximizar a concorrência.

Qualificações e Competências

  • Experiência com DB2 especificamente na versão LUW.
  • Domínio da ferramenta ERwin Data Modeler.
  • SQL Avançado: Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento procedural dentro do banco de dados.
  • Engenharia de Performance: Expertise técnica em criação e gestão de índices, particionamento de tabelas e compressão de dados.
  • Familiaridade com utilitários do DB2 (db2pd, db2top, db2advis) para monitoramento e diagnóstico.
  • Entendimento de como o banco de dados se integra ao pipeline de dados (ETL/ELT) e como otimizar o fluxo de grandes volumes de informação.
  • Domínio de utilitários de movimentação de dados em massa (EXPORT, IMPORT, LOAD e INGEST).

Certificações e Conhecimentos Avançados

  • Certificações IBM DB2 Administrator ou Database Specialist.
  • Conhecimento em integração de dados com ferramentas como InfoSphere - DataStage ou IBM MQ.
  • Experiência com Shell Scripting (Bash) para automação de tarefas no servidor.
  • Noções de infraestrutura (Storage, CPU, RAM) que impactam o comportamento do DB2.

title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division‑level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross‑org architectural decisions, negotiate trade‑offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high‑impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1‑click insurance products).

2026's vision and (how this role contributes)

In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data‑driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences , (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants , and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations . This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance .

Mission design and operationalize the 2–3 year technical end‑state for the Digital Ecosystem so that:

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU),
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue,
  • Insurance launches and scales high‑quality one‑click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.

Core responsibilities

  • Support defining the division’s technical end‑state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade‑offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co‑own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real‑time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one‑click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one‑stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech‑debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post‑mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross‑BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross‑org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.

Key business & engineering metrics you will influence

  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share‑of‑checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.

Job Description

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Engineer (FinOps) , you will build and scale data solutions that drive cost transparency and performance optimization across cloud environments. Leveraging SQL, Python, and modern orchestration tools, you’ll develop pipelines, datasets, and automation frameworks that enable accurate cost attribution and informed financial decision‑making. This role offers strong cross‑functional impact, working with Product, Engineering, and Finance to uncover cost‑saving opportunities and shape scalable, data‑driven FinOps practices.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, develop, and implement tooling and datasets for telemetry‑driven cost attribution and financial modeling;
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and automation frameworks for cost transparency and optimization;
  • Develop systems to identify cost‑saving opportunities and support discount modeling and management;
  • Ensure data accuracy and reliability through validation, auditing, and observability;
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Analytics stakeholders;
  • Improve scalability, performance, and reliability of ELT and ETL pipelines;
  • Support and enhance CI/CD processes and infrastructure automation.

MUST HAVES

  • 4+ years of experience in FinOps , Cloud Engineering , or Data Engineering ;
  • Strong experience with SQL and Python ;
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as dbt , Airflow , or Dagster ;
  • Experience designing and maintaining ELT/ETL pipelines ;
  • Strong background in data modeling and schema design ;
  • Experience with AWS services and Snowflake ;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform ;
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs ;
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP and observability tools like Datadog ;
  • Strong analytical skills with focus on data auditing and validation ;
  • FinOps certification ;
  • Upper‑intermediate English level .

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with Scala;
  • Experience with large‑scale datasets and distributed systems;
  • Understanding of cloud cost optimization strategies;
  • Experience in data‑driven and cross‑functional environments.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

  • Definir e evoluir padrões de arquitetura de software, garantindo consistência entre serviços e soluções desenvolvidas;

  • Apoiar a evolução da arquitetura em ambientes distribuídos e cloud native;

  • Sólida experiência em arquitetura de software em ambientes distribuídos;

title: Analista de Autorizações / Hospital Vera Cruz
description:
Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care.

Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

title: Sr. Mes Analyst (Manufacturing Systems)
description:
Role Summary

The Senior MES Analyst, in partnership with Operational Excellence (OpEx), will work with Production, Quality, and Supply teams to ensure the proper implementation and management of the Manufacturing Execution System (MES – Werum PAS‑X), as well as its ongoing optimization and data extraction for statistical process control.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the PAS‑X lifecycle (analysis, design, build, testing, validation, deployment, and sustainment).
  • Map processes (AS‑IS/TO‑BE) and translate requirements into MES models (eBR/eDHR, recipes, material specs, equipment, parameters).
  • Build and maintain PAS‑X artifacts:
    • GMBR/PMBR with version control and block reuse.
    • PVL/PLL and element libraries (units, equipment, materials, IPC).
    • CIX/Integration configurations (ERP/LIMS/shopfloor) and data mapping.
    • Workflows, rules, checks, sampling, deviations, and electronic signatures (RbE).
    • Weighing/Dispensing, Execution, Review‑by‑Exception, and Release templates.
  • Integrate PAS‑X with SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA, LIMS, historians, SCADA/PLC, and shop‑floor devices.
  • Define, specify, and test MES–SAP integrations (process orders, BOM/recipes, batches, status, WM/EWM, QM, PI sheets where applicable).
  • Execute CSV per GAMP 5 (URS/FRS, Risk Assessment, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability).
  • Ensure compliance (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+).
  • Monitor KPIs and incidents; drive improvements (OEE, RFT, deviation reduction).
  • Train key users; develop SOPs, manuals, and training materials.
  • Support audits, Change Control (ITIL), and CAPA plans.
  • Ensure effective expansion, maintenance, and optimization of PAS‑X in a manufacturing environment.
  • Troubleshoot and provide technical support.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally to analyze production processes, data integration, and drive MES improvements with production teams.
  • Use manufacturing systems to track production performance and establish KPIs, including:
    • Yield: Monitor the percentage of defect‑free products to meet quality standards.
    • Cycle Time: Assess time to complete a production cycle to optimize processes.
    • Resource Utilization: Evaluate machine and labor utilization to maximize efficiency.
    • Inventory Turnover: Measure speed of converting raw materials into finished goods for effective inventory management.
    • Scrap Rate: Track the percentage of discarded materials to minimize waste.
  • Communicate risk situations to EHS per the DISK 1000 program. Prevent unsafe acts by following area procedures.
  • Use and care for assigned PPE.
  • Maintain equipment in your area of responsibility.
  • Safeguard the confidentiality of sensitive information.
  • Comply with the company’s Code of Conduct, policies, and regulations.

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Data Analytics, Chemistry, Biology, and/or Pharmacy.
  • Solid of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Solid experience in MES; 3+ years with Werum PAS‑X in a regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in:
    • Building GMBR/PMBR, PVL/PLL, and libraries in PAS‑X.
    • Configuring MBR/eBR (Dispensing, Execution, Review by Exception).
    • MES–SAP ECC integrations (S/4HANA desirable): PP‑PI (process orders, PI sheets/similar), QM (results/postings), MM/WM/EWM (materials, batches, movements), and common interfaces (IDoc, BAPI, RFC, PI/PO or CPI).
    • CSV/GAMP 5 (URS/FRS, IQ/OQ/PQ, evidence and audit trails). Differential.
    • Compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and Data Integrity. Differential.

Requirements and Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with: Microsoft Office, SAP, Ariba, MODA, PAS‑X.

  • Ability to work under delivery schedules.
  • Project management skills.
  • Ability to lead projects and work both independently and in teams.

  • Experience with at least one automated data transformation.
  • Strong critical thinking and reasoning, especially for troubleshooting data.
  • Passion for solving complex problems and making an impact.

description:
Sobre nós

Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa razão de existir é clara: lutar por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros. E fazemos isso com disponibilidade, acolhimento e agilidade.

Viver pelo cliente

Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.

Agir como empreendedor

Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada

Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeado de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido • Campinas/SP

Nosso time de Tecnologia

Muito mais do que código e sistemas — é o meio essencial que torna possível o nosso modelo único, que combina o melhor do digital com a presença física e humana. Aqui, tecnologia não é um fim em si mesma, mas a ponte entre inovação e a experiência real do cliente. Atuam lado a lado com as áreas de negócio para garantir soluções robustas, escaláveis e centradas nas pessoas, sem abrir mão de um olhar técnico e científico aprofundado em frentes como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura, cibersegurança e arquitetura. É nessa interseção entre propósito, técnica e impacto que constroem o presente e futuro.

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada

  • Propor soluções baseadas em padrões de mercado e melhores práticas Salesforce;
  • Propor soluções com autonomia, apoiando a tomada de decisão de diferentes níveis de liderança;
  • Apoiar o processo de consenso para decisões técnicas de alta complexidade em conjunto com times de negócio arquitetura e liderança técnica;
  • Articular a relação entre as demandas técnicas e de negócio para as equipes de desenvolvedores, considerando fatores internos e externos.

Requisitos

  • Domínio Sales & Service Cloud
  • Conhecimento em Experience Cloud
  • Práticas Agile (Kanban e Scrum)
  • Configuração gerais da aplicação como objetos, campos, registros e regras de validação, processos de aprovação entre outros
  • Sólido conhecimento em hierarquia e visibilidade de dados
  • Domínio em automações
  • Familiaridade com as nativas e customizadas para integração com a Salesforce e melhores práticas de integração
  • Capacidade de criar dashboards e relatórios customizados em Salesforce.

Diferenciais

  • Triple Star Ranger no trailhead.
  • Certificação de Administrador e Platform App builder
  • Demais certificações na ferramenta.
  • Conhecimentos em Eintein Bot, IA, Data Cloud

Benefícios e facilidades

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, Vale-refeição e alimentação e Seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral;
  • Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio-creche, licença-maternidade de 6 meses, licença-paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (com raio de até 50 km de distância). São lugares reserváveis mediante a disponibilidade de assentos e rota. Para quem vai de carro, temos estacionamento gratuito;
  • Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário;
  • Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito: 1% cashback sobre o valor total da fatura do cartão revertido em crédito na fatura seguinte;
  • Conta remunerada: CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI;
  • Isenção de Tarifas de Comunicação Digital;
  • Credito do Trabalhador: taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa;
  • Antecipação Saque aniversário do FGTS;
  • Dr. Pet: possibilidade fazer plano de saúde para pets com até 20% de desconto.
  • Empresa contratante: Hypeflame

Programa Tô de dono

O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui, a fórmula é simples: você cresce. O Agibank cresce com você.

Seu principal desafio será executar e garantir a validação dos resultados da engenharia de dados durante a fase de desenvolvimento para garantir a qualidade, integridade e conformidade dos dados com os requisitos comerciais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver planos de teste de dados abrangentes para garantir a cobertura total do escopo de entrega.
  • Desenvolver scripts de validação automatizados com o apoio dos membros da equipe para garantir testes de dados eficientes e precisos.
  • Projetar casos de teste de dados para cobrir de forma abrangente o escopo de entrega, garantindo a qualidade dos resultados em dimensões-chave, incluindo regras de negócios, requisitos funcionais e padrões internos.
  • Executar casos de teste e documentar os resultados para garantir a transparência e facilitar a resolução de problemas.
  • Desenvolver documentação abrangente descrevendo os processos e padrões de garantia de qualidade.

  • Colaborar dentro de uma estrutura ágil, participando ativamente de cerimônias de sprint para garantir o progresso e o alinhamento contínuos do projeto.
  • Coordenar os resultados e prazos com equipes multifuncionais para garantir a execução oportuna e alinhada do projeto.
  • Contribuir para o processo OKR de qualidade de dados, definindo etapas acionáveis e garantindo que elas sejam atualizadas consistentemente.
  • Assumir total responsabilidade pelo desenvolvimento de scripts de validação automatizados para garantir a validação eficiente e precisa dos dados.
  • Proficiente na definição de melhores práticas e na introdução de novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho para aprimorar as fases de qualidade.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Web Content Editor / Web Qa (Growth Role)
description: Location: Brazil Team: Digital / Web Company Description Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity. Role Overview We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time. You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks. You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience. Key Responsibilities: Content Editing & Publishing Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages. Manage and update content within a CMS (e.G., Sanity, WordPress, or similar). Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Web QA & Quality Ownership Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards. Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies. Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership. Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content. Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review. Qualifications & Skills 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations. Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail. Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS). Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital? Então essa vaga é para você. Sobre a RedSuit Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro. Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time. O que faz um Social Seller? O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais). Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes. Responsabilidades Principais Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo) Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia O que esperamos de você Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos) Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular) O que oferecemos Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance) Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

Conhecimentode SIG;
Conhecimentoem TI/infraestrutura;
Capacidade de análisecrítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes. Habilidades Desejáveis: Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;

Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas. Conduzir processos de Discovery Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais. Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
