title: Engineer Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente. Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes. Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem. Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa. Esperamos que você tenha: Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio). Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk). Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

O que você irá fazer: Supervisionar a alocação de estoque para pedidos B2B de múltiplas marcas que operam nos EUA e na Europa Projetar a disponibilidade de estoque e fornecer visibilidade dos prazos futuros de entrega com base nos recebimentos de estoque Recomendar ajustes ou extensões nos prazos das janelas de entrega para pedidos ou grupos de produtos, conforme a disponibilidade de estoque Coordenar com o financeiro para garantir que os pedidos sejam liberados para cobrança antes dos embarques Liberar pedidos para os armazéns com base nas janelas de entrega e garantir que as priorizações estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio Colaborar com o especialista de logística outbound para acompanhar as prioridades diárias e o progresso junto aos 3PLs Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as equipes de vendas dos clientes, fornecendo atualizações de status, ajustes e feedback sobre os pedidos O que você precisa ter: Fluente em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito Pessoa proativa, orientada a soluções e focada em escalabilidade Experiência em alocação de pedidos, customer success ou gestão da cadeia de suprimentos Tem vontade de aprender a dinâmica de gerenciar múltiplos clientes e varejistas em diferentes países Possui fortes habilidades organizacionais, de comunicação e de resolução de problemas, com grande atenção aos detalhes Tem familiaridade com operações de 3PL, sistemas de gestão de pedidos ou ferramentas de planejamento de inventário (diferencial) Sabe gerenciar prioridades e se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança Observações: Modelo de trabalho remoto Tipo de contrato: PJ

Our alumni are working in over 100 countries, having life changing experiences, travelling the world and improving the lives of others. You will be responsible for academic delivery and ensure excellence in teaching, assessment, and teacher development. progression Fully remote working arrangement Flexible working hours, particularly during off-peak periods

title: Data Engineer Revenue Management
description: Data Engineer Revenue Management Remote (send your resume in English) A Iron Mountain está em busca de um Data Engineer Revenue Management motivado(a) e com fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management (Gestão de Receita Global). Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para garantir dados limpos e acessíveis, transformando dados brutos em insights que impulsionam a melhor segmentação de clientes. Você fará parte de uma equipe de alto impacto dedicada a direcionar a estratégia de preços global para atingir nossas metas de receita e lucro, exigindo coordenação entre as regiões da América do Norte, Europa e América Latina. O Que Você Fará Desenvolver Arquiteturas de Dados Escaláveis: Projetar e manter pipelines de Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (Extração, Transformação e Carregamento - ETL) integrando dados de sistemas operacionais globais usando tecnologias Amazon Web Services (AWS) e Structured Query Language (SQL). Otimizar Processos e Automação: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos internos, redesenhando a infraestrutura para maior escalabilidade e automatizando processos manuais para fornecer conjuntos de dados selecionados para análises e painéis operacionais. Garantir a Excelência Operacional e Governança: Monitorar o desempenho e a qualidade dos pipelines, implementando testes automatizados e padrões de governança de dados alinhados às políticas de segurança da informação da empresa. O candidato ideal terá: fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês 3 a 5 anos ou mais de experiência em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines em ambientes corporativos de grande escala. Sólido conhecimento técnico em modelagem de dados, Structured Query Language (SQL) e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou Scala. Capacidade comprovada em processamento de dados distribuídos (ex: Spark) e no uso de plataformas em nuvem para extração e carregamento de conjuntos de dados complexos. Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada. O Que Oferecemos (Benefícios) Localização: Opções de trabalho remoto ou híbrido para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar: Programa de férias e dias de folga remunerados. Segurança e Futuro: Planos abrangentes de saúde, bem-estar e previdência privada. Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Oportunidades de aprendizado constante e crescimento profissional em uma organização líder global. Pronto para ajudar a proteger e desbloquear o valor da informação? Candidate-se hoje mesmo para integrar nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management e construir as bases de dados do futuro!

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description: About Us: HBX Group is the world's leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We're game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to 'move fast, dream big and make the difference' every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our 'global approach, local touch' mentality. We're headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide. We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers. This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí. Role Overview The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively. Key Responsibilities Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence. Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries. Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system. Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests. Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations. Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols. Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism. Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume. Required Skills and Qualifications Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills. Proficiency in English (spoken and written). Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity. Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently. Ability to follow detailed instructions independently. High attention to detail and adaptability. Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift. If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today! Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model. At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sênior - Dbt Gcp
description: Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração. Descrição do Cargo: O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados. Principais Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT, com otimização de macros e templates. Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL. Implementar e manter processos de ETL, garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados. Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados. Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis. Requisitos e Qualificações: ✅ Experiência sólida com DBT, modelagem de dados e práticas de orquestração de pipelines. ✅ Conhecimento avançado em BigQuerye Looker e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP). ✅ Proficiência em SQL para otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados. ✅ Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados. ✅ Conhecimento avançado em ETL (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, DataStage, Hadoop e entre outras). ✅ Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas. ✅ Diferencial: Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados. Benefícios e Diferenciais: ♂ Parceria com TotalPass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas. Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados. Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers. Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas. Contratação PJ. Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro. Sobre a ATRA: A ATRA é referência em tecnologia e inovação, atuando há mais de 15 anos no mercado de engenharia de dados, data analytics, governança e privacidade. Somos parceiros de grandes empresas como Microsoft, Google, Informatica, Denodo, Atlan e BigID, desenvolvendo soluções que transformam dados em ativos estratégicos. Com um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, buscamos profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia e transformação digital. Se interessou pela vaga? Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Desenvolvedor (A) Kernel Sistemas De Alto Desempenho
description: Responsabilidades e atribuições Configuração, compilação e integração do kernel Linux utilizando ferramentas com o Buildroot e Yocto. Implementação de novos device drivers, adaptação de device drivers existentes para novas arquiteturas. Adaptação de bootloaders, como U-Boot e OpenSBI, para novas plataformas e geração da descrição de hardware em mecanismos como device tree. Colaboração com equipes de firmware e hardware para integração de kernel, bootloader, device tree e drivers à uma nova plataforma de hardware. Requisitos e qualificações Bacharelado ou mestrado em Ciência ou Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica/Eletrônica ou áreas relacionadas. Proficiência na linguagem C e em assembly, com foco em sistemas de alto desempenho e em desenvolvimento para ambientes sem sistema operacional (bare metal) e em kernel-space. Ao menos 5 anos de experiência com a adaptação (porting) e bring-up do kernel Linux para novos plataformas, e implementação e adaptação de device drivers. Conhecimentos sobre a arquitetura e detalhes de implementação do kernel Linux, como gerenciamento de memória, escalonadores, processos, threads, etc. Experiência com ferramentas para geração de sistemas Linux, como Buildroot e Yocto, e ferramentas de emulação e depuração, como QEMU e GDB. Desejável : Conhecimentos da arquitetura RISC-V, em especial assembly para RISC-V, processo de boot, Supervisor Binary Interface (SBI), mecanismos de interrupção (CLINT, PLIC, APLIC), modelo de memória, mecanismos de sincronização e operações atômicas. Conhecimento em otimização de desempenho. Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls (chamadas de sistema) para utilizar os recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V. Conhecimentos e experiência com bootloaders e códigos de inicialização: UEFI, U-Boot, EDK II, Open-SBI. Contribuições em projetos de código aberto. Conhecimento em análise e otimização de desempenho. Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls para utilização dos recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V Experiência na caracterização (profiling) de desempenho de aplicações e uso de ferramentas como perf e eBPF.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. title: Product Owner

O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia. Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação. Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados. Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico. Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais. Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto. Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência. Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos. Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis. Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese. Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais. Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário. Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto. Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares. Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos. Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais. Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada. Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog. Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders. Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia. Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade. Requisitos desejáveis Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico, agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais. Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde. Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade. Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais. Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde. Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional. Competências esperadas Forte senso de dono sobre o produto Excelente capacidade de priorização Visão de negócio com foco no usuário Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável Escuta ativa e boa facilitação Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto Alto nível de autonomia e accountability O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde. Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia. Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia. As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário. A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio. Diferencial importante Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Product Designer

Strong collaboration skills and a user-centered mindset. Experience using tools such as user journey mapping, flow diagrams, and prototyping techniques. Experience designing native mobile applications (iOS and Android). Experience working on products in early-stage or product-market fit environments. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Lead Crypto Research Analyst
description: About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH) Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation. Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals. Key Responsibilities Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit. Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market. On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health. Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps. description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description United Hub Digital (UHD) is a nearshore IT consulting firm helping mid and large US enterprise clients accelerate their data and technology initiatives. Headquartered in Greenville, SC, with a delivery hub in Brazil, we embed directly into client teams as a trusted execution partner across data analytics, software development, UI/UX, and project management. We hold ourselves to the same standards of accountability and delivery quality our clients expect from their own teams. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to 'make the data AI-ready': well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed. Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ What You Will Do Semantic Modeling Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.) Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption Data Documentation and Context Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata AI Readiness Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope Governance and Quality Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Qualifications Required 5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline Hands-on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud) Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.) Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on Nice to Have Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

title: Data Scientist
description:
Be a part of a fast‑paced culture and community in a startup‑like environment inside one of the most successful organizations in Québec. We are focused on building a highly talented and ambitious team from the ground up that revolutionizes the way we work around Data & Analytics at BRP. We are a team that has the potential to unlock tremendous value for the organization and you have the unique opportunity to be part of it from the beginning.

Join BRP's central Data & Analytics team (DNA) as a Data Scientist and bring your analytical skills and business insight to our dynamic team. This role is perfect for someone who seeks to blend their understanding of business intelligence with the predictive power of data science to unlock new opportunities for BRP.

You’ll Have The Opportunity To
  • Partner with Product Manager, Product Owner and business stakeholders to identify high‑impact opportunities and translate business questions into well‑defined analytical problems and ML use cases
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non‑technical stakeholders through compelling data storytelling
  • Design and develop machine learning models and statistical analyses that directly address business needs, with clear success metrics tied to outcomes and ensure model validity, fairness, and interpretability
  • Design and execute rigorous A/B tests, experiments, and causal inference studies to validate model performance and measure business impact
  • Stay current with rapid developments in ML/AI, especially foundation models, LLMs, and agentic systems, evaluate their applicability to business problems, and champion adoption where appropriate
You’ll Thrive In This Role If You Have The Following Skills And Qualities Education & Experience
  • MSc (preferred) or BSc in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or equivalent quantitative field
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience applying data science and machine learning to solve real business problems
  • Demonstrated track record of projects where your work drove measurable business outcomes
Technical Skills
  • Strong Python proficiency for data analysis, modeling and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs and tools (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar) for prototyping and implementing AI‑powered solutions
  • Solid SQL skills and experience querying data warehouses (Snowflake experience is a plus)
  • Familiarity with at least one end‑to‑end ML platform (Dataiku, Databricks, Vertex AI, SageMaker) for experimentation and model development
  • Understanding of ML fundamentals: model evaluation, cross‑validation, hyperparameter tuning, bias‑variance tradeoff, MLOps
Language Requirements
  • Fluent in English (spoken/written), team communication is primarily in English
  • French is a huge plus
Stand Out With
  • Experience building production applications or proof‑of‑concepts using LLMs, including prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval‑Augmented Generation), or fine‑tuning approaches
  • Familiarity with emerging AI agent frameworks and orchestration tools
  • Experience with model explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME) and fairness/bias assessment in production contexts
  • Familiarity with the handoff process to production: understanding of model monitoring needs, drift detection, and retraining triggers
  • Background in a specific domain relevant to our business and Machine Learning expertise
  • Contributions to open‑source projects or publications demonstrating thought leadership
  • Experience mentoring junior data scientists or leading analytical initiatives
Acknowledging the Power of Diversity

BRP is dedicated to nurturing a culture that invites, connects, and propels the ambitions of people of all backgrounds, profiles, beliefs and experiences. Ultimately, the diversity and uniqueness of our people fuel our ingenuity and set the course for the path ahead! For this reason, we value diversity and we strive to always push each other forward to build an inclusive workplace where every employee feels like they belong, where they can grow and find meaning.

Welcome to BRP

We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt and even in the air. Headquartered in the Canadian town of Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a spirit of ingenuity and intense customer focus. Today, we operate manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia and Austria, with a workforce made up of close to 16,500 spirited people, all driven by the deeply held belief that at work, as with life itself, it’s not about the destination; It’s about the journey.

This position is based in Campinas, Brazil. You will have the opportunity to work in hybrid mode. Resumes in English will be preferred.

Olá, somos o Grupo Destaque!

Nosso Grupo, começou suas atividades em 1967 com a abertura do escritório de contabilidade Eco. De lá para cá, em meio a turbulências ora por ordem econômica, ora por crises políticas e conflitos de ordem social, nunca deixamos de acreditar na força e potencial de nosso país.

E com muita dedicação, empenho e perseverança, conseguimos trilhar por uma trajetória de sucesso, ampliando e diversificando nossas atividades. Onde você irá trabalhar:

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Program Manager to lead global initiatives across multiple regions, with a strong focus on analytics-driven products within BEES ONE. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in managing complex projects, possess exceptional communication and negotiation skills, and effectively manage cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Fluency in English is required, while proficiency in Spanish is highly desirable but not mandatory.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys working with data-oriented initiatives, and is motivated by delivering insights that drive business decisions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Program Management: Lead the end-to-end implementation of multiple concurrent projects, from initial planning through execution and phased deliveries.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide clear and consistent updates on project status, proactively identify and address critical issues, and ensure transparent communication across multiple teams and business areas.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the key point of coordination between Product, Engineering, Data, and Design teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Strategic Planning and Execution: Drive quarterly planning cycles, defining project roadmaps, timelines, prioritization, and resource allocation using tools like Jira.
  • Analytics Product Delivery: Oversee the development and delivery of analytics dashboards, ensuring alignment with business needs and enabling data-driven decision-making.
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and blockers, actively driving resolution and maintaining project momentum.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize data and performance metrics to track progress and ensure successful delivery of initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute to improving project management processes, enhancing efficiency, and scaling best practices across the team.
  • Support and Customer Service: Ensure delivered solutions meet internal customer needs, particularly supporting commercial and business teams with actionable insights.
Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
  • Experience: Proven experience managing multiple mid-sized technology or data-related projects in parallel, ideally within global or product-driven environments.
  • Skills: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and drive alignment across diverse teams.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory (advanced level preferred). Proficiency in Spanish is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge: Experience or familiarity with data/analytics environments is a strong plus.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira) and agile methodologies.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and support decision-making processes.
  • Attributes: Proactive, hands-on, highly communicative, and able to manage multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and blockers effectively.

Hands‑on experience building multi‑agent systems using frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, LangFlow) and communication protocols (MCP, WebMCP, A2A).

Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

#vemserhospitalcare #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhc #jeitodeserhc #jeitodeserhospitalcare

  • Delegar e coordenar o desenvolvimento das atividades da Auditoria Interna e CAD, visando garantir a eficácia do trabalho realizado

description:
Descrição da vaga

To work in Extreme Conditions X-ray Diffraction and Spectroscopy Group (EXT) of the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).

LNLS/CNPEM is seeking a Senior Researcher to lead the Extreme Conditions X-ray Diffraction and Spectroscopy Group (EXT) at SIRIUS, Brazil’s fourth-generation synchrotron light source. The selected candidate will also serve as scientific coordinator of the EMA beamline.

The EXT group brings together experimental infrastructure dedicated to structural and electronic studies of matter under extreme conditions of pressure, temperature, and external fields, integrating multiple experimental and laboratory platforms, including:

EMA Beamline (to be coordinated by the selected candidate)

X-ray diffraction and spectroscopy experiments at high pressure and temperature;

Use of diamond anvil cells and resistive/laser heating;

In situ structural and electronic studies in materials science, geosciences, and condensed matter.

Seriema Beamline (under development)

Fast and large-scale diffraction and spectroscopy experiments using micrometric beams at high pressure.

High-Pressure Laboratory

Sample preparation and characterization;

Experimental and instrumental development associated with pressure cells;

Support for synchrotron experiments and the user community.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Lead the EXT group and define its scientific strategy;
  • Coordinate the operation and scientific program of the EMA beamline;
  • Promote integration between EMA and Seriema beamlines and the high‑pressure laboratory;
  • Manage a multidisciplinary team of researchers, engineers, and technicians;
  • Develop new experimental methodologies in diffraction and spectroscopy under extreme conditions;
  • Establish national and international collaborations and strengthen the user community;
  • Foster scientific programs in quantum materials, geosciences, and functional materials under extreme conditions.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • PhD in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, or related fields;
  • Advanced English;
  • Solid experience in high‑pressure X‑ray techniques (diffraction and/or spectroscopy);
  • Track record of work at large‑scale scientific facilities (preferably synchrotrons);
  • Experience in scientific leadership, team management, and coordination of complex projects;
  • Strategic vision and ability to integrate instrumentation development, science, and user support;
  • Strong publication record and international recognition in the field.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer neds, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you'll do

Be a leading voice in team discussions and decisions. Focus on the whole team’s productivity and strive to increase the impact of the team’s work product.

  • Develop and propose software solutions following the best practices and patterns.
  • Be an expert on different development and test flows.

  • Work with software architects, engineering managers, and product owners to create and maintain test automation for our products.
  • Provide technical guidance to the team

What you'll need

  • Experience with software, systems, and infrastructure architecture
  • Experience with Java, Spring framework, and Python
  • Experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with microservices architecture and patterns
  • Experience in micro-frontends pattern
  • Experience with event-driven architecture

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ
  • Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps/VSTS) tools, and containerizing applications (Kubernetes), Cloud Hosting (Azure)
  • Experience using monitoring and metrics to support KPIs and the performance of APIs

More about you

  • You´re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality.
  • You´re motivated by building up front-end solutions and are aware of its different architectures.
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates DevOps culture.
  • You´re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions.
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands.
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.
